'''Centaurs''' are [[fanciful]] [[creature]]s which are merely the stuff of [[legends]]. They do not actually exist, appearing only in [[engraving]]s as the fancy of artists. They may be added properly into the game in future releases. A female centaur is known as a ''centauress''.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] centaurs for their ''strength''.


[[File:Brooklyn Museum - Centauress - John La Farge - overall.jpg|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''strength''.]]

{{D for Dwarf}}

Some [[Troll|trolls]] like centaurs for their [[milk]].
